items.text: Rangers trade Leonys Martin and Anthony Bass to the Mariners for Tom Wilhelmsen and James Jones
Athletics trade Tyson Ross and A.J. Kirby-Jones to the Padres for Andy Parrino and Andrew Werner
Randy Johnson becomes a free agent (Giants)
Rockies trade cash, Juan Pierre and Mike Hampton to the Marlins for Charles Johnson, Preston Wilson, Vic Darensbourg and Pablo Ozuna
Cal Ripken becomes a free agent (Orioles)
Rockies trade Darryl Kile, Luther Hackman and Dave Veres to the Cardinals for Manny Aybar, Brent Butler, Rich Croushore and Jose Jimenez
Tony Perez signs with the Red Sox
Cubs trade Ralph Kiner to the Indians for cash
